mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.status, u.is_locked, u.created_at, u.deleted_at, GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roles FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.status, u.is_locked, u.created_at, u.deleted_at
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `user` GROUP BY status
SELECT r.role_name, COUNT(ur.user_id) AS count FROM role r LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT role_name FROM role ORDER BY role_id
